#!/usr/bin/env python3

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PUBLISHER = ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/gate_chain_publisher.py"
QUEUE = ROOT / ".git/universal-worker-queue"

JOB_ID_MAX = 120


def run(args, check=True):
    p = subprocess.run(
        args,
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=False,
    )
    if check and p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(p.stdout)
    return p


def git(*args, check=True):
    return run(["git", *args], check=check)


def current_sha():
    p = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    return p.stdout.strip()


def build_job(args):
    if len(args.job_id) > JOB_ID_MAX:
        raise ValueError("JOB_ID_TOO_LONG")

    job = {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-job.v2",
        "job_id": args.job_id,
        "objective": args.objective,
        "production_allowed": False,
        "requester": {
            "source": "chatgpt",
            "project": args.project,
            "chat": args.chat,
        },
        "target_repo": args.repo,
        "target_branch": args.branch,
        "base_sha": current_sha(),
        "human_summary_language": "es",
        "actions": [],
        "checks": [
            {"type": "repository_contract_audit"},
            {"type": "git_diff_check"},
        ],
    }

    return job


def build_chain(job):
    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.gate-chain.v1",
        "chain_id": f"{job['job_id']}-CHAIN",
        "enabled": True,
        "max_hops": 1,
        "start_gate_id": "GATE",
        "adopt_existing_job_ids": [],
        "gates": [
            {
                "gate_id": "GATE",
                "job_id": job["job_id"],
                "mutation_class": "READ_ONLY",
                "next_gate_ids": [],
                "job_template": job,
            }
        ],
    }


def submit(args):
    job = build_job(args)
    chain = build_chain(job)
    decision = {
        "state": "READY",
        "next_gate_id": "GATE",
    }

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="edarsa-workerctl-") as tmp:
        tmp = Path(tmp)

        chain_path = tmp / "chain.json"
        decision_path = tmp / "decision.json"

        chain_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(chain, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        decision_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(decision, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        plan = run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                str(PUBLISHER),
                "--chain-json",
                str(chain_path),
                "--decision-json",
                str(decision_path),
            ]
        )

        print("===== PLAN =====")
        print(plan.stdout)

        data = json.loads(plan.stdout)

        if data.get("status") == "EXISTS":
            print("JOB_ALREADY_EXISTS")
            return 0

        if data.get("status") != "READY_TO_PUBLISH":
            raise RuntimeError("JOB_NOT_READY_TO_PUBLISH")

        if not args.publish:
            print("PLAN_ONLY=YES")
            return 0

        published = run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                str(PUBLISHER),
                "--chain-json",
                str(chain_path),
                "--decision-json",
                str(decision_path),
                "--publish",
            ]
        )

        print("===== PUBLISH =====")
        print(published.stdout)

        return 0


def status(args):
    job = args.job_id

    print(f"JOB={job}")

    found = False

    for lifecycle in (
        "pending",
        "processing",
        "results",
        "done",
        "rejected",
        "rejected_history",
        "blocked",
        "failed",
    ):
        path = QUEUE / lifecycle / f"{job}.json"

        if path.is_file():
            found = True
            print()
            print(f"===== {lifecycle.upper()} =====")
            print(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    if not found:
        print("LOCAL_LIFECYCLE=NOT_FOUND")

    git("fetch", "origin", "worker/requests", check=False)

    remote = git(
        "ls-tree",
        "-r",
        "--name-only",
        "origin/worker/requests",
        check=False,
    )

    needle = f"worker_queue/inbox/{job}.json"

    if needle in remote.stdout:
        print("REMOTE_REQUEST=PRESENT")
    else:
        print("REMOTE_REQUEST=NOT_FOUND")

    return 0


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="EDARSAHUB Universal Worker control-plane facade"
    )

    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    s = sub.add_parser("submit")
    s.add_argument("--job-id", required=True)
    s.add_argument("--objective", required=True)
    s.add_argument("--project", default="13. Produccion")
    s.add_argument("--chat", default="Bitacoras de Parrilla")
    s.add_argument("--repo", default="rbalam/EDARSA_HUB")
    s.add_argument("--branch", default="Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    s.add_argument("--publish", action="store_true")
    s.set_defaults(func=submit)

    st = sub.add_parser("status")
    st.add_argument("--job-id", required=True)
    st.set_defaults(func=status)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    return args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
